key_insight: GeoABC makes neural operators boundary-aware by using wall geometry to apply different corrections along tangential and normal directions, better matching near-wall aerodynamics.
engineering_relevance: This improves surrogate CFD accuracy where it matters most for design: surface-pressure and other near-boundary quantities that strongly affect aerodynamic performance.
method: Geometry-conditioned boundary correction injected into intermediate neural-operator features
Anisotropic treatment of boundary physics: tangential propagation vs. normal constraint
Pluggable across multiple neural operator backbones
evidence_signal: On 2D airfoil and 3D car benchmarks, GeoABC reduces near-boundary relative L2 error by about 38% on average and narrows the near-wall performance gap.
watch_item: The approach depends on reliable boundary geometry encoding and may require extra care to transfer across meshes, shapes, or CFD settings with different wall-resolution quality.
paper_title: Geometry-Aware Anisotropic Boundary Correction for Aerodynamic Simulation
